newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Resources Beijing Land offers 300 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: China Resources Beijing Land offers 300 mln shares.

text.p: China Resources Beijing Land Ltd, a China property spinoff of China Resources Enterprise Ltd, said on Monday it planned to offer 300 million shares at a price ranging HK$2.18 to HK$2.36 per share.
The final price is expected to be fixed on Friday, it said in a statement.
The company said 15 percent of the issue or 45 million shares was for public subscription in Hong Kong and 85 percent or 255 million shares for international placement.
Public subscription will begin on October 29 to November 1 and dealing in shares is expected to begin on November 8.

It has an option to increase the Hong Kong portion to a maximum of 30 percent of the share offer if the IPO is oversubscribed while shares for the placemant would be reduced accordingly, the company added.
Based on an issue price of the maximum of HK$2.36, the prospective price/earnings multiple on a weighted average basis is 9.3 times and prospective dividend yield is 3.1 percent.
The issue is sponsored by Anglo Chinese Corporate Finance Ltd and co-sponsored by Credit Lyonnais SEcurities (Asia) Ltd and Morgan Stanley Asia, Beijing Land said.
The sole material asset of China Resources Beijing Land is its 62.5 percent equity interest in Beijing Huayuan Property Co Ltd, a land development and investment company in Beijing.
The proceeds will be solely used for Beijing Huayuan's further development, it added.
